title: What Is Pluto TV? Pricing & How It Works
summary: What is Pluto TV and how does it work? This guide covers everything you need to know about the free ad-supported platform, Pluto TV.
body_markdown:
TL;DR


5


Quick Takeaways


Five things consumers and marketers need to know about Pluto TV.


1. 1


Pluto TV offers free, ad-supported live and on-demand streaming.


2. 2


Viewers get cable-like channel surfing without subscriptions or credit cards.


3. 3


Its scale spans hundreds of channels and thousands of titles.


4. 4


Advertisers gain broad reach, targeting options, and measurable conversions.


5. 5


MNTN activates Pluto TV inventory through targeting, optimization, and reporting.
